name: @sjawhar/pi-legion
//: test: each command's --timeout is at least twice the slowest row or hook it ran under 8 busy loops on 2 CPUs at 61b66deb or 84270ff (builds Jobs) or on CI; one hook and the rows beside it keep a guard of their own, the last two lines here.

The first, 15000: under the loops rig-isolation.test.ts's beforeAll took 3,408.91 ms and the slowest row 2,100.99 ms at 61b66deb; on CI (the builds farm runs no Docker) no judge-omp row of rig.test.ts but the first took more than 3,342.44 ms (job 126217454413, push run 41722033995) over the 1,341 green jobs the last line names, and the first's time was the judges' image's pull, which that hook now makes. Read again at the round-3 class-search tree (main 46c275dcba with #4437's head e9d8f5075f and its uncommitted fixes), the whole command under the same load (two runs in builds Job d2-c9-pl, 2026-11-19), with main's #4400 row rig-isolation.test.ts's run whose bun cannot read the profile settings among them: the slowest row, a link run's working directory holds the crontab its prompt cites, 2,096.52 ms (2,003.29 ms in the second run, Legion OMP extension > claims/ready failing transiently three times). Read again at #4437's round-4 tree 24b2e96b28, with merge a77fd967f7's rows (23 in this command, in extensions/legion.test.ts and src/model-fallback.test.ts) and 67f8ef7140's seed.test.ts beforeAll, the whole command under the same load (three runs in builds Job g4b-pl-first, legion-load-run-7xf8s, 2026-11-21, with Oh My Pi and a NATS server, each hook timed by a preload the Job's patch added, since Bun prints no hook times): the slowest hook, rig-isolation.test.ts's beforeAll, 4,907.50 ms (3,913.37 and 3,997.30 ms in the other runs), which 15000 holds 3.06 times; the slowest row, that crontab row, 3,719.36 ms; the merge's slowest row, a typed controller claim that waited, landed and then failed at its controller topic leaves no waiting line, 1,603.45 ms; seed.test.ts's beforeAll at most 16.90 ms. scripts/skill-scenarios/score.test.ts and judge.test.ts run in the fourth command.

The second, 300000: a call the abort does not end: the worker ends its own process ..., 117,806.72 ms under the loops (77,259.43 ms on CI). Read again at the round-3 class-search tree (main 46c275dcba with #4437's head e9d8f5075f and its uncommitted fixes) (two runs in builds Job d2-c9-pl, 2026-11-19, the same load): that row, 124,397.30 and 137,291.80 ms, which 300000 holds 2.19 times. Read again at #4437's round-4 tree 24b2e96b28, with merge a77fd967f7's rows of controller-start-omp.test.ts and legion-model-fallback-omp.test.ts, under the same load (three runs in builds Job g4b-pl-omp, legion-load-run-j5lsl, 2026-11-21, with Oh My Pi and a NATS server, each hook timed by a preload the Job's patch added): that row, 127,086.03 ms, the slowest (121,813.24 and 117,087.01 ms in the other runs), which 300000 holds 2.36 times; the slowest hook, controller-start-omp.test.ts's afterEach at its line 162, 401.22 ms; the merge's slowest row, a person's controller claim the listener keeps answering 503 shows each wait and then fails on screen, 34,614.66 ms.

The third, 1215000, runs scripts/skill-scenarios/daemon-pane.test.ts alone: its first row's `go run` compiles the daemon's own functions, which a fresh checkout does on a cold Go build cache, as a builds Job does. Under the same load that row took 381,115.42 ms on a cold cache in builds Job d2-c9-pl (run 1, 2026-11-19; 5,313.71 ms warm in its run 2) and 592,009.53 ms with an empty GOCACHE in builds Job d4-final2 (2026-11-20), the slowest, so the guard is twice that plus 30 s; CI's pi-legion job restores the go-daemon cache before it, so CI runs it warm. It has a command of its own, as pi-envoy's -omp files do, so the other -omp files keep 300000.

The fourth, 45000, runs scripts/skill-scenarios/score.test.ts and judge.test.ts. score.test.ts's beforeAll hooks wait on the processes they start through the shared wait: the staging hook writes the world score.ts reads (1,355 directories and 3,649 files, on the memory root) and runs the seven `git` commands that build the pushed-code run's repository, and the next hook runs `bun score.ts runs` over that world. A wait in a beforeAll counts from the row-deadline mark taken before the file's first hook, so this guard holds those hooks together. Under the loops (five runs in builds Job legion-load-run-whlmz, 2026-11-20, at #4437's tree 040ffd56bd), from that mark to the end of the scoring hook took 5,485.99 ms to 6,792.36 ms: the staging hook at most 1,982.67 ms (its seven `git` runs 296.43 ms to 485.97 ms together), the scoring hook at most 4,986.90 ms, its child using 290 ms to 570 ms of CPU. The slowest row was score.test.ts's live-read row, 1,095.26 ms; judge.test.ts's slowest, a judge whose answer does not cover its input fails the run naming the file, 309.46 ms, and its judgeRun beforeAll 106.36 ms. So the guard is twice 6,792.36 ms plus 30 s, 43,584.72 ms, rounded up.

rig.test.ts's judge-omp beforeAll, which pulls the judges' image once for the file (rig.sh judge-image), has its own guard, 240000: the first judge-omp row paid for that pull until it moved there, and took 119,329.07 ms in job 134109871047 of #4267's pull-request run 44097039395 (2026-11-17T15:00:12Z), the slowest; over the 1,341 green pi-legion jobs of main's merge-group and push runs, 2026-10-29T12:58Z to 2026-11-17T16:22Z, every one of whose logs GitHub kept, it took at most 15,772.79 ms (job 126587011431, push run 41833651040).

rig.test.ts's judge-omp rows that run a judge (judgeRow) have their own guard too, 90000: each holds its judge's docker run, past this command's 15000 on a loaded dev box; the slowest of five dev-box runs at 70978a40 with no row limit, each started at a 1-minute load of 1,011 to 3,003, was the gateway row at 31,374.69 ms (run 1, load 3,003 to 2,405; INFRA-3904's lanes, 2026-11-17 21:56-22:00Z, logs under /mnt/scratch/sami/TriageBunLoopStall.lJ5iY6/runs/judge-load.aWJXXI/ on the dev box).

scripts.build: bun build extensions/legion.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --external @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent --external @oh-my-pi/pi-tui --external @oh-my-pi/pi-utils
scripts.test: bun test --preload ./test/omp-logs.ts --preload @legion/test-fixtures/row-deadline --timeout 15000 --path-ignore-patterns '**/*-omp.test.ts' --path-ignore-patterns '**/daemon-pane.test.ts' --path-ignore-patterns '**/score.test.ts' --path-ignore-patterns '**/judge.test.ts' && bun test --preload ./test/omp-logs.ts --preload @legion/test-fixtures/row-deadline --timeout 300000 ./extensions/*-omp.test.ts && bun test --preload ./test/omp-logs.ts --preload @legion/test-fixtures/row-deadline --timeout 1215000 ./scripts/skill-scenarios/daemon-pane.test.ts && bun test --preload ./test/omp-logs.ts --preload @legion/test-fixtures/row-deadline --timeout 45000 ./scripts/skill-scenarios/score.test.ts ./scripts/skill-scenarios/judge.test.ts
